Operational Description

The command for activating the heated rear windscreen is given by the special switched housed in the climate control system control unit M070. The command is sent to the body computer node M001 (pins 6, 8 and 10 connector D) via the CAN; the supply via the CAN is protected by fuse F24 of the body computer M001.

The control unit M070 communicates the information that the heated rear windscreen is on to the instrument panel E050 as well at pins 5 and 9 and from there to the various displays [EL4010].

The body computer node M001 activates the internal relay and supplies the heated rear windscreen P055. The line is protected by fuse F26, also located in the body computer.

The defrosting of the door mirrors P060 and P061 is also activated simultaneously. The command is supplied by the body computer node M001 to the door nodes M066 and M067 via the CAN, namely from pins 21, 23, and 24, 26 connector L to pins 14, 3 connector A of the driver's door node M066 and the passenger door node M067.

The door nodes M066 and M067 receive a supply via the CAN (pin 1 connector A) from the line protected by fuse F04 of the body computer M001.

The door nodes M066 and M067 are supplied by the body computer node at pin 16 connector from the line protected by fuse F09.

Both the door nodes supply the internal resistance for the door mirrors P060 and P061 from pins 4 and 5 of connector B.
